takeon_base.carried: Covered: the reinsurances to close effective 1 January 2021 (Syndicate 780 and 1897 2018 and prior; Syndicate 1200 2017 and prior with Syndicate 4000 2018 and prior). The p25 gross triangle holds them on both diagonals of the 2012-2018 columns: it restates its earlier diagonals. The 2012-2018 step is only +109.1m although about $1.36bn of gross reserves for those years came in on 1 January 2021, and the report year's 2021 column cannot hold them (see below). So the transferred reserves do not enter the step. Split: covered amount = 178.9 + 78.6 + 1,100 = $1,357.5m, built from the stated transaction amounts; the last is stated only as '$1.1 billion'. Not covered: the in-year loss portfolio transfers ($193.9m + $345.2m + $534.6m + $19.6m = $1,093.3m, each stated as one gross-and-net figure). They are consistent with the report year's own 2021 column (first-year estimate 1,078,053, identical in the gross and net tables), which is outside the sum. Unsettled and left out: the Syndicate 1897 2019-year loss portfolio transfer ($17.6m gross, $17.3m net), which has no 2019 column. The filing also does not separate any pre-2012 years of the reinsurances to close, which would sit in 'Reserve in respect of prior years' (no development rows), so $1,357.5m is an upper bound on the covered part. The stated transactions sum to $2,468.4m, against Note 7's 'Reinsurance of new liabilities 2,425,117'. Opening: balance sheet claims outstanding at 31 December 2020 is 770,428; Note 7's 774,037 adds the 3,609 unexpired risk provision.
